text:
1	# Hello
2	
3	A single static page. No build step, no dependencies. It renders one centered
4	greeting — "Hello, and welcome." — on a dark background, and nothing else. The
5	favicon is a white "H" on a rounded square in the same dark colour as the page.
6	
7	## Files
8	
9	| Path | Purpose |
10	| --- | --- |
11	| `index.html` | The whole page — markup and inline styles |
12	| `favicon.svg` | Favicon for modern browsers |
13	| `favicon.ico` | Fallback favicon for browsers that ignore the SVG |
14	
15	## Run it locally
16	
17	Open the file directly:
18	
19	```sh
20	open index.html
21	```
22	
23	Or serve it over HTTP, which matches production more closely:
24	
25	```sh
26	python3 -m http.server 8000
27	# then visit http://localhost:8000
28	```
29	
30	## Deploy
31	
32	Live at **https://suleimansh.github.io/test-project/**
33	
34	Deployment is GitHub Pages, driven by `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`. Every push to
35	`main` publishes the site; it can also be run by hand from the Actions tab.
36	
37	One-time setup is already done on `suleimansh/test-project`: the remote exists and
38	the Pages source is set to GitHub Actions (**Settings → Pages → Build and
39	deployment → Source: GitHub Actions**). A fresh fork or clone needs both steps
40	repeated before its first deploy will publish.
41	
42	Because this is a *project* Pages site, it is served from the `/test-project/`
43	subpath rather than the domain root. Asset links in `index.html` are therefore
44	relative (`favicon.ico`, not `/favicon.ico`) — a root-absolute path resolves to
45	`suleimansh.github.io/favicon.ico` and 404s.
46	
47	The workflow copies only `index.html`, `favicon.ico`, and `favicon.svg` into the
48	published artifact. The repository root is *not* deployed wholesale — anything not
49	in that list (for example `.the-framework/`, which holds internal run logs and
50	analysis notes) is never reachable from the public site. If you add a file that
51	should be served, add it to the `Stage site` step or it will not ship.
